description.from:
## Scope

Ship a small offline walkthrough and explicit live interfaces around the native, provider-neutral Decision Flywheel optimizer. Do not add DSPy or another orchestration framework.

## Definition of done

Documented local workflow, reproducible fixtures, release-ready package, and evidence links for native optimization; no optional DSPy integration is in scope.
